visual.title: How far can the bound move?
visual.caption: The allowable range keeps the same active set. For x + 2y the bound can move from 2.5 to 10 before a nonnegativity bound joins or leaves the basis.

predict.question: While both resource constraints stay active, what is the allowable range for the bound x + 2y?
predict.explain: Solving the two active equalities for x and y gives x = (10 − b)/3 and y = (2b − 5)/3. Requiring both nonnegative gives 2.5 ≤ b ≤ 10.
